_readme: Verified findings you add by hand. Each key is a Wikidata ID of a company (for example Q1234). Only add a finding if you have a source anyone can open. Tiers: judgment (court), regulator (agency decision), reporting (credible journalism). lvl: 1 = minor, 2 = serious. cat: env, lab, law or pol. Copy the _example entry, rename its key to the real Wikidata ID, and fill it in.

findings.text: One or two plain sentences describing what the source says.
findings.source: Name of the agency or outlet and document title
